name: A temporary replacement on the action bar is saved as the spell it replaces (#5469)
contract: Custom-class talents swap a known spell for a variant through Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement, learning the variant with learnSpell(..., true) so it is never written to character_spell. The Witch Doctor's Malefic Arrow talent 707854 ('Transforms your Malefic Wrath into Malefic Arrow') is one: AscensionWitchDoctor::SyncReplacements learns Malefic Arrow 801674 as a temporary spell and replaces Malefic Wrath 807037 with it. #5469 reports that Malefic Arrow disappears at login; the server log shows 'ActionButton loading problem, will be deleted from db ... action: 801674'. Player::_SaveActions wrote the variant's id, and at the next login Player::_LoadActions runs before the replacement is learned again, so IsActionButtonDataValid refuses the unknown spell and the button is deleted. The same log drops a Bloodmage's Transgression 801076 from AscensionTalentReplacementData the same way. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes for a button. A button holding the temporary variant must be saved as the spell it replaces, which survives the login and is replaced again once the talent's swap runs; a button holding an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The talent replaces Malefic Wrath with Malefic Arrow
The Malefic Arrow button is saved as Malefic Wrath
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
